en.headline: Link Hong Kong Open offers free public admission for opening rounds
en.dek: The 65th edition continues at Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling through Sunday, with free entry on Thursday and Friday and complimentary access for under-18s all week.
body: The 65th Link Hong Kong Open is under way at the Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling, running from 22 to 25 October with a prize fund of US$2 million.

Organisers said admission is free for the public on the opening rounds of Thursday and Friday. Spectators aged 18 and under receive complimentary entry throughout the four-day event. Weekend tickets are priced at HK$200 per day or HK$300 for a weekend pass.

Local player Taichi Kho, a two-time Asian Tour champion, is competing in the field. The tournament is organised by the Hong Kong Golf Association and the Hong Kong Golf Club, and forms part of the Asian Tour’s International Series. The winner earns an invitation to the Masters and a place in The Open Qualifying Series.

zh.headline: 領展香港高爾夫球公開賽首兩日免費開放公眾入場
zh.dek: 第65屆賽事在粉嶺香港哥爾夫球會舉行至周日，周四及周五免費入場，18歲或以下人士全周免費。
body: 第65屆領展香港高爾夫球公開賽正於粉嶺香港哥爾夫球會舉行，賽期由10月22日至25日，總獎金200萬美元。
主辦單位表示，開賽首兩日即周四及周五免費開放予公眾入場。18歲或以下人士於整個賽事周可免費入場。周末單日門票為200港元，周末通票300港元。
本地球手、兩屆亞巡賽冠軍許龍一正參與角逐。賽事由香港高爾夫球總會及香港哥爾夫球會主辦，屬亞巡賽國際系列賽一部分。冠軍可獲美國大師賽邀請及英國公開賽資格系列賽席位。
